# Mladen Djuric (MacMladen)

> Mladen Đurić (MacMladen) is a senior developer and architect with two decades of building for the web — and a computing story that starts with assembly on 8-bit machines. He runs Blue Fish, a full-service digital agency in Novi Sad, shipping WordPress and Drupal sites alongside modern stacks like Astro, Next.js, and React Native.

Personal site, five pages, English only. Based in Novi Sad, Serbia. Reachable
at mladen@macmladen.com, on LinkedIn (rs.linkedin.com/in/macmladen) and on
GitHub (github.com/macmladen). Slides are on speakerdeck.com/macmladen.

## Pages

- [Home](https://macmladen.com/): who Mladen is, and the workshop coming next.
- [About](https://macmladen.com/about/): the long-form story, from 8-bit assembly and fifteen years of typography to WordPress, Drupal and the web.
- [Speaking](https://macmladen.com/speaking/): talks and workshops at WordPress and Drupal events across Europe, newest first.
- [WordPress, Docker and AI agents — hands-on](https://macmladen.com/speaking/2026/wordcamp-belgrade-ddev-ai/): the WordCamp Belgrade 2026 workshop, 18 September 2026 at Dom Omladine Beograda, held in Serbian, with the prerequisites and the registration form.
- [Contact](https://macmladen.com/contact/): email, the profile links, and a contact form.
